claimBoundary: A successful render is not by itself a theorem about transport, a biological reconstruction, intelligible speech, or listener perception.

items: Every number (anatomy, foods, styles) is invented: no measurement, no source.
The canal is 20 cm or longer because the World's 24 modes must lie inside its band; a real one is shorter.
Digestion is a reservoir refill rate, not chemistry; the gas is energy, not a fluid with composition or temperature.
Everything the tract does not model applies (one jet, mode-diagonal losses, stepped moves).

output.about: fart.rs's listener: pressure x 1/1000, clamped to [-1, 1] by the tract's listener, then its 20 Hz one-pole DC blocker (a listening stage, not part of the World; the ledger is untouched)
output.observes: the radiated pressure at the cleft and the stub (Pa)

outputDigestCovers: every frame rendered, interleaved left/right, f32 little-endian
